item.title: USGL Profess House Capital Campaign
item.description: As announced in November of 2025, United States Grand Lodge completed the purchase of a large building in central Connecticut. This property represents the first Profess House to be established under U.S.G.L. in its history. We have set the ambitious goal of raising $100,000 over the next six months.
